verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents some automation-adjacent features: scheduled Automatic Check-ins, reusable project templates, an API, CLI access, and MCP support for AI agents. None of the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Scrolling back through chat history and reusing templates are adjacent features, not version control for automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
